when you announce a Scrounging action:
do you have to announce how many cards you want to look at?
do you have to announce how many cards you want to put in your hand?

or is it more like the 'search library' style cards, wherin you can
search first, and decide what to get after searching. except in this
case, you'd look at upto 3 cards once the action is successful
(presumably you don't get to look at one, think it's no good, look at
the next, then decide, hell, i'll got for the third) and then after
looking get to decide how many to put in your hand.

thanks,

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
salem wrote:
> when you announce a Scrounging action:
> do you have to announce how many cards you want to look at?

Since you will always look at the maximum possible, this isn't an issue.

> do you have to announce how many cards you want to put in your hand?

No.

> or is it more like the 'search library' style cards, wherin you can
> search first, and decide what to get after searching. except in this
> case, you'd look at upto 3 cards once the action is successful
> (presumably you don't get to look at one, think it's no good, look at
> the next, then decide, hell, i'll got for the third) and then after
> looking get to decide how many to put in your hand.

It doesn't matter if you look at one and then another or if you look
at them all at once.
